title: SR-6.11 One product site
request: Closes G102: the seed-stage analysis (B9, B10). The product repository still holds the older template site (site/: web/, landing/, build.mjs, DEPLOY.md), whose pages carry titles and taglines of their own (site/web/business.html) beside the README's line and the deployed site's, and whose guard against certification, uptime and SLA claims (test/deploy-docs.test.mjs) checks pages no visitor sees. QL-1.06 runs the claims check over site/**/*.html, so the template is checked while the deployed site is not. Repository: memev. Depends on contracts: SR-5.04, SR-6.10, QL-1.06.

tasks.title: The template site is retired and its guard lives on where visitors are
requirements: the certification, uptime and SLA guard runs in memev-site's CI first (SR-6.10 task 2), and the change note names the memev-site commit and the CI run that show it

site/ is removed from the product repository, with the tests that only read it; nothing in memev's docs, tests, workflows or scripts refers to it afterwards, and the claims step no longer globs site/**/*.html
pages the template held that the deployed site lacks are listed in the change note for the site's owner; none is copied here
the README's tagline is the status table's positioning entry (SR-5.04), so the product repository states one line

criteria.statement: SR-6.11 retired: site/ does not exist, every workflow glob and docs link resolves to a file that exists, and no file outside changelog.d refers to site/web, site/landing or site/build.mjs; on the base tree the test fails

verifier.cmd: out=$(node --test --test-reporter=tap --test-name-pattern='^SR-6.11 retired' test/site-retired.test.mjs 2>&1); rc=$?; printf '%s\n' "$out" | tail -30; [ $rc -eq 0 ] && printf '%s\n' "$out" | awk -v pat='^SR-6.11 retired$' 'BEGIN { n = split(pat, alt, "|") } function flush(  i) { if (cand != "") for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (cand ~ alt[i]) hit[i] = 1; cand = "" } /^[[:space:]]*(not )?ok [0-9]+ - / { flush(); name = $0; sub(/^[[:space:]]*(not )?ok [0-9]+ - /, "", name); if ($0 ~ /^[[:space:]]*ok / && name !~ /# (SKIP|TODO)/ && name !~ /\.test\.m?js$/) cand = name; next } /^[[:space:]]*type: .suite./ { cand = "" } END { flush(); for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (!hit[i]) exit 1; exit 0 }'

criteria.statement: The change note names the memev-site commit and CI run that carry the guard
